assumptions.statement: The repository provisional site and key-area polygons are rough constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All computed geometry areas and ratios must be recalculated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setback, road redline, ownership, utilities and engineering controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: These values remain unknown; no statutory or approval claim is made.

assumptions.statement: No cleared parcel-level existing-building inventory is used.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are conceptual prototype envelopes; retain/renovate/demolish decisions require survey and ownership review.

assumptions.statement: Eight personas are working hypotheses, not reported research participants or findings.
assumptions.impact: Thresholds, language, comfort and accessibility details must be co-designed with affected users.

assumptions.statement: The package defines six load dimensions but no universal personal comfort threshold.
assumptions.impact: Pilots test choice, legibility, rollback and equivalence before any threshold is standardized.

assumptions.statement: Pilot operators, maintenance budget and procurement routes require named public owners.
assumptions.impact: Each pilot has a proposed accountable role and exit gate, not an implementation promise.

assumptions.statement: International standards are method references and national laws are applied only within their actual scope.
assumptions.impact: Professional legal and planning review is required before procurement or statutory use.

assumptions.statement: The interface identifies the authoring system as OpenAI Codex but does not expose an exact serving model identifier.
assumptions.impact: The agent record states that limit and does not invent a model version.
